SavedBlueprint.title: SavedBlueprint
SavedBlueprint.description: A generated and normalized 3D architectural spatial blueprint persisted to Firestore for a signed-in user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who generated and owns this architectural model.

name.description: Display name of the architectural model.

inputMode.description: Architectural image interpretation mode used to generate the blueprint.

prompt.description: Optional user design notes used during generation.

roof.description: Roof configuration map containing style, hex color, and overhang in meters.

rooms.description: Bounded list of normalized architectural room definitions (1 to 40 rooms).

walls.description: Bounded list of wall definitions with door/window openings (0 to 120 walls).

furniture.description: Bounded list of composite furniture item placements including custom AI-generated pieces (0 to 150 items).

roomCount.description: Cached room count for summary listing.

areaSqMeters.description: Cached floor area in square meters.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the blueprint was first saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the blueprint was last updated.

FurnitureAsset.title: FurnitureAsset
FurnitureAsset.description: A prompt-generated 3D composite furniture asset stored in the user's reusable Firestore furniture catalog.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who generated and owns this furniture piece.

name.description: Display name of the furniture piece.

description.description: Short architectural style and material description.

prompt.description: User prompt that generated this furniture batch.

width.description: Bounding width along local X in meters (0.2 to 6.0).

depth.description: Bounding depth along local Z in meters (0.2 to 4.5).

height.description: Bounding height along local Y in meters (0.2 to 3.2).

parts.description: Bounded list of 1 to 16 composite 3D primitive part definitions (native Firestore maps).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the furniture asset was generated.

/blueprints/{blueprintId}.description: User-owned generated 3D architectural blueprints stored as native Firestore maps and lists.

/furnitureAssets/{assetId}.description: User-owned prompt-generated 3D furniture catalog pieces stored as native Firestore maps and lists.
